profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your teammates see your name. Trading partners see your organization, not you.
profile.name: Name
profile.homeHint: Preselected where a location is needed (for example delivery). It doesn't limit what you can use.

language.title: Language
language.description: The app language for you, and the language of your emails. Product names and messages stay as written.
language.label: Language

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it signs out your other devices. You'll be asked to confirm your current password first.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

email.title: Login email
email.description: To change it, both the current and the new address must confirm through emailed links within 24 hours.
email.pendingTitle: Change to a new address in progress
email.completeHint: Both addresses must be confirmed. You'll be signed out everywhere and log in with the new address.
email.completedDescription: Log in again with your new address.

states.RECONCILING: Being finalized — don't start another change

sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.description: Sign out devices you don't recognize. Signing out everywhere includes this device.
sessions.revokeAllDescription: This includes this browser; you'll need to log in again.

external.title: Google and Apple sign-in
external.description: Link an account to log in with it. Linking or unlinking signs out your other devices.
external.unlinkDescription: You'll be signed out everywhere and log in with your password or another linked account. Confirm with that other method first.

deactivate.title: Leave the organization
deactivate.description: Deactivates your login in {org}. Your past work stays. Only an owner or admin can reactivate you.
deactivate.confirmDescription: You'll be signed out everywhere and won't be able to log in until someone reactivates you.
deactivate.notStaff: Owners and admins can't deactivate themselves. An owner must first transfer ownership; an admin needs the owner.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose how you hear about each event. These choices are yours alone. Security notices are always sent.
notifications.deliveryNote: Email and push delivery depend on the service being enabled for your company's region.

devices.title: Devices for push notifications
devices.description: Phones and browsers registered to receive push notifications. Signing out of a device stops its notifications.
devices.webUnavailable: Push notifications in the browser aren't available yet.
devices.mobileUnavailable: Registering this phone for push notifications isn't available yet.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Activity on your orders and partners from the last 90 days.
